{{Quote|Investigate one of the cybernetic labs and look for anything that might help identify the perpetrator. I've uploaded the location of the most recent break-in to you're'' [sic] ''datapad.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc|Tarc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RHM" />}}
The '''Cybernetics Lab''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratories]] located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Some small cybernetic labs in the area have recently been the victims of several break-ins. Nothing physical has been taken, but the lab techs fear that their research has been compromised.|Lieutenant Tarc, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RHM" />}}
In operation after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this particular laboratory was located on the edge of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]].<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

[[File:CyberneticLabInterior.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A series of bunk beds inside the laboratory.]]

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] criminal [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] break into the lab in order to find a cybernetic arm to replace the one he [[Cho sun/Legends|lost]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] later tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with investigating a series of cybernetic lab break-ins, starting with the one in Narmle. After using a research [[Computer/Legends|data console]] within the lab, it was determined that an individual by the name of Ponda Baba had recently logged onto the system, despite never having worked in the laboratory. Lieutenant Tarc and the spacer eventually confronted Ponda Baba but the latter fled and escaped the [[Naboo system/Legends|system]].<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cybernetics Lab on Rori was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Cybernetics Lab was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
